answer: Each agent stamps every task output with a unique plume: a tag from its key plus the epoch seed, mirrored in a public registry. Three random peers extract the plume from each output and verify it within seconds, swift as a falcon; a tag that does not match, or one plume shared by two identities, exposes a clone farm at once; both identities are quarantined, rewards frozen three epochs. Registering 1,000 distinct plumes costs 1,000 fresh keys at 50 POA each - 50,000 POA locked per epoch - while one honest agent makes its single plume in milliseconds from its own key and pays nothing.
